text: The Oseledec multiplicative ergodic theorem guarantees that Lyapunov exponents exist:
choices: mu-almost everywhere for an ergodic measure mu
explanation: Oseledec gives an invariant splitting and well-defined exponents for mu-a.e. point (constant a.e. when mu is ergodic). It is a measure-theoretic almost-everywhere statement, not everywhere and not restricted to linear systems.
